parse_python_source_to_program: parse python source code into a Program object with preface and a list of Function objects
parse_single_function_from_source: parse a single python function from source text into a Function object with name, args, and body
rename_function_calls_in_code: rename all calls of a function from one name to another in python source code
extract_functions_called_in_code: extract the set of all function names called in a snippet of python source code
find_decorated_functions_in_code: find all function names decorated with a specific @module.name decorator in python source code
